shared_elements: low relief carving on light tan stone slab
horizontal band/register of small repeated motifs
row of small human-like or figural forms across an upper zone
flat vertical slab format with carved surface
incised linear outlines rather than fully modelled forms
justification: Both are pale, tawny stone slabs worked in shallow relief, and each carries a horizontal band of small repeated figural motifs running across an upper zone above larger or denser carving below, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is an irregular, weathered upright with a few large, isolated animal figures rendered in bold naturalistic outline in situ, while B is a finished, symmetrical round-topped plaque densely and regularly filled with ruled horizontal rows of small, standardised signs under a winged emblem.
